resumes.text:
RILEY MAYNARD
Cybersecurity & Software Graduate | Incident Response | IT Operations | Secure Development
(717) 501-1740 | ril3ymaynard@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/riley-maynard99/ | github.com/Zecktix
SUMMARY
Penn State cybersecurity graduate (B.S., May 2026) who combines Fortune 500 incident response experience, three-plus years of
enterprise IT support, and hands-on software development. Builds security into what I ship, from zero-dependency Node.js
applications to a revenue-generating startup. Fluent with Microsoft Sentinel, KQL, Wireshark, ServiceNow, and JavaScript.
EXPERIENCE
Cyber Incident Response Intern | Highmark Health (Remote)Jun 2025 – Aug 2025
•Investigated, triaged, and escalated 60+ security incidents, analyzing network traffic and logs in Microsoft Sentinel and
Wireshark to identify indicators of compromise
•Improved team triage speed by 27% by documenting recurring incident patterns so repeat alerts could be closed faster
IT Operations Specialist | Penn State University (Full-time)Sep 2022 – May 2026
•Resolved 30+ daily tickets in ServiceNow across Windows and macOS (hardware, software, network, endpoint) while
maintaining SLA compliance
•Wrote knowledge base articles for recurring fixes, reducing repeat tickets and giving teammates reusable troubleshooting
steps
Co-Founder | Vayla (Hair Accessory E-Commerce Startup)Nov 2025 – Present
•Ran 500+ customer interviews to validate demand, then designed, built, and launched the website and brand to first revenue
in under four months
•Grew to thousands of monthly visitors and $1,000+ in monthly revenue; won $15,000+ in funding from 4 pitch competitions
PROJECTS
Pulseboard | JavaScript, Node.js, HTML & CSS | github.com/Zecktix/PulseboardNov 2026
•Built an analytics dashboard that turns Shopify data into revenue trends, profit metrics, and automated business health
insights
•Designed for security: read-only Shopify integration and a zero-dependency server to minimize attack surface and
supply-chain risk
Momentum | JavaScript, Node.js, HTML & CSS | github.com/Zecktix/MomentumNov 2026
•Built a self-hosted task, habit, and calendar app with user accounts using only Node.js built-in modules and vanilla JavaScript
•Implemented input validation and login rate limiting to reduce injection and brute-force risk
Pathfinder | JavaScript, Node.js, Ollama (Llama 3.2), REST APIs, HTML & CSSNov 2026
•Built a self-hosted, AI-powered job board that aggregates thousands of live listings from the Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby
job-board APIs, with ranked keyword search, filters, and resume-based job matching
•Integrated a local LLM (Llama 3.2 via Ollama) to tailor resumes and write cover letters on-device, keeping resume data
private; secured with scrypt password hashing, HttpOnly sessions, and login rate limiting
SKILLS
Security: Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Wireshark, Snort, Nmap, Palo Alto Networks, Cofense; NIST, ISO/IEC 27001, CMMC
Development: JavaScript, Node.js, Python, SQL, KQL, Java, C/C++, HTML/CSS; Git, VS Code, AWS
IT & AI Tools: ServiceNow, Windows, macOS, Claude Code, Microsoft Copilot
Spoken Languages: English (native), Spanish (conversational), Japanese (basic)
EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS
Penn State University | B.S., Cybersecurity and Analytical OperationsMay 2026
Minors: Security Risk Analysis; Information Science & Technology
Certifications: CompTIA Security+ (in progress) | NSA CAE-CD and SRA-UCT certificates
Competitive Cyber Security Organization | OperationsAug 2022 – September 2025
•Competed in cyber defense events including Hivestorm, placing in the top 10% of 400 teams
